# Woodpecker puzzles 7 to 12 (Steinitz)

For each puzzle: paste the PGN block into **Paste a FEN or PGN**, set the title, and paste the note. Puzzle 11 is missing because its solution text belongs to a different game (see below).

## 7. Steinitz – Baker, London (simul) 1868

Black to move.

**Title:** 7. Steinitz – Baker, London (simul) 1868

**Note:** The queen is overloaded and White loses the bishop on c4. 27...Rxc4?! 28.Qxc4 f3 29.Qf1 is of course not the way to go.

```
[FEN "2r1k2r/1b1p2q1/p4p2/4p3/PpB1Pp1p/7P/1PPRQPP1/4R1K1 b - - 0 27"]
[SetUp "1"]

27. ... f3 28. Qxf3 Rxc4 *
```

## 9. Steinitz – Fleissig, Vienna 1873

White to move.

**Title:** 9. Steinitz – Fleissig, Vienna 1873

**Note:** White wins back the piece with a winning advantage. 39...Rxb4+ captures a pawn, but the a-pawn still decides after 40.Bxb4 Kxd7 41.Kb5.

```
[FEN "1b6/3n1p2/r1k1p1pp/Pr2P3/1PK2P2/3R4/3B2PP/R7 w - - 0 39"]
[SetUp "1"]

39. Rxd7 Kxd7 40. Kxb5 *
```
